question_en: Switch to the read mode that reads only a 20-pixel-wide band centered on CCD row 50.
answer: read_mode == 'single_track', single_track_center == 50, single_track_width == 20, all three fields simultaneously.
setup: Start with read_mode at fvb. Restore fvb afterwards.
todo_from_sheet: No tool returns the single_track center/width (set_ccd_read_mode returns only read_mode, hbin, Nx_ro, Ny_ro, and get_ccd_info has none). The grading code must read the driver attributes ro_single_track_center / ro_single_track_width directly.
BLOCKER: No read-back path: neither the set_ccd_read_mode nor the get_ccd_info return contains the single_track center/width. The grading code must read the driver attributes (_ccd.ro_single_track_center / ro_single_track_width) directly.
overlap: S08 and this item reset each other's read_mode. The setup of one is the answer of the other.
